foils.code:
def transform(grid):
 g=[r[:] for r in grid]; ps=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==4]
 if not ps:return g
 a,b=min(r for r,c in ps),max(r for r,c in ps); x,y=min(c for r,c in ps),max(c for r,c in ps)
 for r,c in [(a,x),(a,y),(b,x),(b,y)]:
  if g[r][c]==0:g[r][c]=2
 return g
